prose: Axios reports Salesforce agreed to buy AI customer-research startup Listen Labs, reportedly for $2 billion. Listen Labs raised a $69M Series B at a $500M valuation in January. Axios sees customer research as ripe for AI disruption as companies replace manual methods. Based on the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Salesforce to acquire Listen Labs, reportedly for $2B
Listen Labs raised $69M at a $500M valuation in January
